question: What manufacturer warranty periods are listed in Table 2A-5 for each retroreflective sheeting type?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Table 2A-5 does not list manufacturer warranty periods for any retroreflective sheeting type. The table specifies minimum maintained retroreflectivity levels (in cd/lx/m²) by sign color and sheeting type (ASTM D4956 beaded Types I, II, III, and prismatic sheeting), along with additional criteria such as overhead vs. post-mounted applications, bold/fine symbol sign distinctions, and special cases. No warranty information appears anywhere in the provided evidence, so the question cannot be answered as posed. Standards (mandatory): - "Public agencies or officials having jurisdiction shall use an assessment or management method that is designed to maintain sign retroreflectivity at or above the minimum levels in Table 2A-5." - Per the table's footnote: "This sheeting type shall not be used for this color for this application" (marked with an asterisk for certain sheeting type/color combinations). Guidance (recommended): - One or more of the methods described in "Maintaining Traffic Sign Retroreflectivity" (FHWA-SA-07-020, Revised 2013), or a method developed based on an engineering study, should be used to maintain sign retroreflectivity at or above the minimum levels in Table 2A-5; signs identified as being below the minimum levels should be replaced. Options (permitted): - Highway agencies may exclude certain signs from the retroreflectivity maintenance guidelines: Parking, Standing, and Stopping (R7 and R8 series) signs; Walking/Hitchhiking/Crossing (R9 series, R10-1 through R10-4b) signs; Acknowledgment signs; and Bikeway signs intended for exclusive use by bicyclists or pedestrians. Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows Table 2A-5, "Minimum Maintained Retroreflectivity Levels," which contains retroreflectivity values (e.g., W ≥ 120; G ≥ 15 for post-mounted white-on-green signs) organized by sign color and sheeting type, with no column or entry for manufacturer warranty periods. Citations: - Table 2A-5 (p.62) - Section 2A.22 Standard §2 (p.62) - Section 2A.22 Guidance §4 (p.62) - Section 2A.22 Option §5 (p.63)
